author: SinOfStrife
name: LinkQuoter
short: Quotes Discord message links with rich previews, persistent delete buttons, and flexible cross-server modes.
description: Automatically or manually quotes Discord message links into rich embeds with thread breadcrumbs, persistent delete controls, and flexible cross-server security modes. Adapted from LinkQuoter by PhenoM4n4n and AAA3A.
install_msg: Thanks for installing LinkQuoter! Note: Auto-quoting is disabled by default. Use `[p]linkquoteset` to configure server settings or `[p]linkquote <url>` to quote manually.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store personal data about users.
